WP_STEPS|/prepE/overview: Requirement for the substrate: even, free of adhesion inhibiting substances, sealed in the surface, pore open, load-bearing, extensively fully grouted. Depressions > 5 mm, mortar pockets, plaster grooves in brickwork, open butt or bed joints, damaged areas, large-pored substrates or uneven masonry work must be levelled in advance with {M30}.
WP_STEPS|/prepE/points/0: before any application, remove all loose or poorly bonded layers from the wall footing and the transition to the splash water plinth down to the cementitious substrate
WP_STEPS|/prepE/points/1: edges are to be chamfered and corners are to be rounded
WP_STEPS|/prepE/points/2: level indentations < 5 mm with {M30} / {AQ1K} or a mixture of {RB400} and quartz sand 0.1–0.35 mm (approx. 6 kg to 24 kg)
WP_STEPS|/prepE/points/3: high-pressure water jetting (> 400 bar; < 2000 bar) and blasting are suitable measures; the last step is cleaning with pressure water
WP_STEPS|/prepE/points/4: pre-moisten the dry substrate so that it is matt damp at the time of application; extremely absorbent and slightly sandy substrates are primed with {PRIM}, which must have reacted fully
WP_STEPS|/prepE/points/5: moisture penetration from the rear must be avoided; for waterproofing with moisture from the rear, pre-seal with {AQ1K} or ASODUR-SG3-thix
WP_STEPS|/cove/title: Install the sealing cove with ASOCRET-M30
WP_STEPS|/cove/short: Bonding slurry of AQUAFIN-1K or ASOCRET-M30, then the cove, edge height 4–6 cm, rounded, wet in wet.
WP_STEPS|/cove/overview: Base slab–wall transition: pre-screen with {AQ1K} or {M30} in a consistency that is able to screen. While still wet, install a sealing cove with an edge height of at least 4 cm made of {M30} and round it off. After drying, carry out the waterproofing.
WP_STEPS|/cove/points/0: {M30}: water 4.5–5.25 l per 25 kg, mixing time approx. 3 minutes, maturing 5 minutes, homogenise again; pot life approx. 45 minutes
WP_STEPS|/cove/points/1: consumption of the sealing cove approx. 3 kg/m
WP_STEPS|/cove/points/2: the cementitious sealing cove can be overcoated after approx. 3 hours with the waterproofing system
WP_STEPS|/cove/points/3: alternatively the fillet is formed with ASO-Dichtband-2000-S (system page)
WP_STEPS|/cove/points/4: in the area of structural movement joints the waterproofing is reinforced with ADF-Dehnfugenband or ASO-Dichtband-2000-S
WP_STEPS|/pipe/short: AQUAFIN-RB400 with the notched trowel, the pipe sleeve bonded free from folds and fully overcoated.
WP_STEPS|/pipe/overview: For the watertight formation of pipe penetrations, the system components of the ASO-Dichtmanschetten (sleeves) or ADF-Rohrmanschette are used in accordance with their technical data sheets: {RB400} is applied with a 4 mm notched trowel and smoothed, the sleeve is bonded free from folds and subsequently fully overcoated.
WP_STEPS|/pipe/points/0: in water impact class W2.1-E, suitable loose/fixed flange constructions or tested house entry systems must be used
WP_STEPS|/pipe/points/1: on PVC, gunmetal and stainless steel flanges the sleeves are installed without voids or wrinkles and integrated seamlessly into the waterproofing
WP_STEPS|/pipe/points/2: direct contact with metals such as copper, zinc and aluminium is avoided by a pore-sealed primer of ASODUR-GBM in two steps
WP_STEPS|/mixRB/short: Liquid component into the bucket, powder in, 3 minutes; mature 5 minutes; homogenise again.
WP_STEPS|/mixRB/overview: Put the liquid component into a clean mixing bucket and mix with the powder component to produce a homogeneous, lump-free mass (mix ratio A : B = 1.5 : 1 by weight). The mixing time is approx. 3 minutes. After a settling period of approx. 5 minutes, thoroughly homogenise the compound again.
WP_STEPS|/mixRB/points/0: stirrer approx. 500–700 rpm with a suitable mixing paddle
WP_STEPS|/mixRB/points/1: depending on the application technique (screen or spray), do not add more than max. 0.24 l water per 24 kg; water is added after mixing
WP_STEPS|/mixRB/points/2: pot life approx. 45 minutes at approx. 5–30 °C
WP_STEPS|/mixRB/points/3: do not add water or new material to material that has already set
WP_STEPS|/coatE1/title: Apply the first coat of AQUAFIN-RB400
WP_STEPS|/coatE1/short: Brush, trowel or spray, free of pores; an even thickness with the coating-thickness or notched trowel, then smoothing.
WP_STEPS|/coatE1/overview: Apply {RB400} in a minimum of two application steps ensuring it is free of pores. An even layer thickness is achieved using a coating thickness trowel or notched trowel and then smoothing. The material rate depends on the required dry film thickness corresponding to the water impact class.
WP_STEPS|/coatE1/points/0: can be trowelled off and applied with a brush; machine application after Technical Information No. 43
WP_STEPS|/coatE1/points/1: in case of strong sunlight, work against the movement of the sun in shaded areas
WP_STEPS|/coatE1/points/2: protect surfaces that are not to be treated
WP_STEPS|/coatE1/points/3: the waterproofing must not be affected by water during binding: the effect of water from behind can lead to spalling in case of frost
WP_STEPS|/coatE2/title: Apply the second coat after approx. 3 hours
WP_STEPS|/coatE2/short: When the first coat can no longer be damaged by reworking; to the dry film thickness of the class.
WP_STEPS|/coatE2/overview: The second application step (and following) can take place when the first application step can no longer be damaged by reworking — overcoat after approx. 3 hours. Total dry film thickness ≥ 2.0 mm (concrete, W1-E/W4-E), ≥ 3.0 mm (masonry), ≥ 4.0 mm (W2.1-E).
WP_STEPS|/coatE2/points/0: rainproof on inclined surfaces after approx. 3 hours; standing water must be avoided
WP_STEPS|/coatE2/points/1: sealing against pressing water (1 bar) after approx. 16 hours; withstands pressurised water after ≥ 1 day
WP_STEPS|/coatE2/points/2: transitions of watertight concrete components (immersion depth ≤ 3 m, opening ≤ 1.0 mm): 15 cm on both sides of the joint, two steps, 4 mm dry film with a 6–8 mm notched trowel; or the ASO-Dichtband system overcoated ≥ 2.5 mm
WP_STEPS|/coatE2/points/3: {RB400} as a surface coating must not be exposed to point or linear loads
WP_STEPS|/board/title: Bond the protection and drainage boards
WP_STEPS|/board/short: AQUAFIN-RB400 mixed with quartz sand 0.1–0.35 mm, buttering-floating with the notched trowel; perimeter insulation fully bonded.
WP_STEPS|/board/overview: The waterproofing must be protected against weathering influences and mechanical damage using suitable protective measures in accordance with DIN 18533. For the bonding of suitable protection/drainage boards and perimeter insulation boards, {RB400} is mixed with quartz sand 0.1–0.35 mm (approx. 6 kg per 24 kg) and applied with a suitable notched trowel using the buttering-floating method.
WP_STEPS|/board/points/0: depending on the water impact class, bonding is either spot application or covering the whole area
WP_STEPS|/board/points/1: perimeter insulation is installed butt-jointed and offset in accordance with the manufacturer, fully bonded with {RB400}
WP_STEPS|/board/points/2: alternatively bonding is carried out with the 2-component bituminous thick layer coating COMBIDIC-2K-CLASSIC or COMBIDIC-2K-PREMIUM
WP_STEPS|/board/points/3: drainage is carried out in accordance with DIN 4095
WP_STEPS|/cureE/short: Keep damp for at least 3 days in dry conditions; ventilate pits; protect against mechanical damage before backfilling.
WP_STEPS|/cureE/overview: The material cures very well in areas with high humidity. In relatively dry areas, keep the coating damp for at least 3 days. In poorly ventilated rooms and deep pits, adequate ventilation should be provided for 24 hours.
WP_STEPS|/cureE/points/0: the waterproofing must not be affected by water during binding
WP_STEPS|/cureE/points/1: protect the fresh coating from rain, frost and direct sunlight; standing water must be avoided
WP_STEPS|/cureE/points/2: backfill only against the protected waterproofing (DIN 18533)
WP_STEPS|/cleanS/short: Clean tools immediately after use with a suitable solvent. Store frost-free, 5–40 °C.
WP_STEPS|/cleanS/overview: Clean tools immediately after use with suitable solvent. Store in a frost-free, cool and dry place: at min. 5–40 °C for 12 months in the original container. Promptly use opened containers.
WP_STEPS|/cleanS/points/0: observe the applicable safety data sheets of both components
WP_STEPS|/cleanS/points/1: very low emission — EMICODE EC 1PLUS: positive evaluations within DGNB, LEED, BREEAM, HQE
WP_STEPS|/planI/title: Assess the exposure and the substrate
WP_STEPS|/planI/short: WTA 4-6: which water acts from behind, how much salt is in the masonry — the class sets the number of coats.
WP_STEPS|/planI/overview: Retroactive waterproofing of building components in direct ground contact in accordance with WTA datasheet 4-6. The slurries withstand negative pressing water up to 0.75 bar. Soil moisture and non-pressurised water: > 2.0 mm dry film; standing seepage water / pressure water: > 3.0 mm ({AQ2K}: 5.3 kg/m²; {AQ1K}: three application steps in the classic system).
WP_STEPS|/planI/points/0: the classic system with {AQ1K} is for substrates that are not at risk of cracking; for substrates that are subsequently prone to cracking use {RB400} (the flexible system with radon protection) or {AQ2K}
WP_STEPS|/planI/points/1: before use the existing test certificates and the WTA datasheet “Subsequent waterproofing of components in contact with the ground” must be observed
WP_STEPS|/planI/points/2: in rooms with high humidity and insufficient ventilation, condensation on the surface must be avoided with condensation dryers; direct heating or blowing warm air is not permitted
WP_STEPS|/planI/src: AQ1K · AQ2K · RB400 · M30 · system page
WP_STEPS|/prepI/title: Remove the plaster, prepare the masonry
WP_STEPS|/prepI/short: Plaster off 80 cm beyond the damage, salt-laden joints raked out 20 mm, jetted clean, levelled with ASOCRET-M30, matt damp.
WP_STEPS|/prepI/overview: The damaged plaster is removed at least 80 cm beyond the damaged area; salt-laden joints are scraped out approx. 20 mm deep and the surfaces cleaned mechanically. Depressions, mortar pockets, plaster grooves, open joints and uneven masonry work are levelled in advance with {M30}; a sealing groove/fillet is formed at the floor–wall transition.
WP_STEPS|/prepI/points/0: requirement: load-bearing, even, pore open, sealed in the surface, free of adhesion inhibiting substances
WP_STEPS|/prepI/points/1: high-pressure water jetting (> 400 bar; < 2000 bar); the last step is cleaning with pressure water
WP_STEPS|/prepI/points/2: ESCO-FLUAT converts sulphate and chloride salts into less soluble compounds (system page)
WP_STEPS|/prepI/points/3: pre-moisten to matt damp, no puddles; very absorbent substrates are primed with {PRIM}, which must be dry before the next step
WP_STEPS|/prepI/points/4: {M30}: 3–30 mm in one step, approx. 1.4 kg/m² per mm; sealing cove approx. 3 kg/m; overcoat after approx. 3 hours
WP_STEPS|/barrier/short: AQUAFIN-i380 injection cream (or AQUAFIN-F) in a row of drill holes; holes resealed with ASOCRET-M30.
WP_STEPS|/barrier/overview: System “Basement waterproofing: the classic system”: {AQF} creates the retroactive horizontal damp-proof barrier against capillary rising damp; the flexible and the day system use the injection cream {I380}. The drilled holes are resealed with {M30}.
WP_STEPS|/barrier/points/0: the barrier stops the capillary transport in the wall; the slurry then waterproofs the face against water from behind
WP_STEPS|/barrier/points/1: products of the subgroups “Injection” and “Mortars and restoration plasters” — follow their technical data sheets
WP_STEPS|/mix1K/short: Approx. 6.7 l of water per 25 kg, mix approx. 3 minutes, lump-free.
WP_STEPS|/mix1K/overview: Put approx. 6.7 l of water per 25 kg into a clean mixing bucket and mix with the powder component to produce a homogeneous, lump-free mass. Mixing time approx. 2–3 minutes.
WP_STEPS|/mix1K/points/0: stirrer approx. 500–700 rpm with a suitable mixing paddle
WP_STEPS|/mix1K/points/2: pot life approx. 60 minutes at approx. 5–30 °C ({AQ1KP}: approx. 30 minutes)
WP_STEPS|/mix1K/points/3: do not add water or new mortar to mortar that has already set (risk of inadequate strength development)
WP_STEPS|/coatI1/title: Apply the first coat of AQUAFIN-1K
WP_STEPS|/coatI1/short: Brush, trowel or spray into the matt damp substrate, free of pores; up to 1 mm per step.
WP_STEPS|/coatI1/overview: Apply {AQ1K} in a minimum of two application steps ensuring it is free of pores. An even layer thickness is achieved using a coating thickness trowel or notched trowel and then smoothing. Max. layer thickness per application step: up to 1 mm ({AQ1KP}: 2 mm).
WP_STEPS|/coatI1/points/0: the substrate may be matt damp; the formation of puddles must be avoided
WP_STEPS|/coatI1/points/1: consumption approx. 1.75 kg/m² per mm; in total approx. 3.5–5.3 kg/m²
WP_STEPS|/coatI1/points/2: can be trowelled off and applied with a brush; machine application after Technical Information No. 43
WP_STEPS|/coatI2/title: Apply the second coat after approx. 6 hours
WP_STEPS|/coatI2/short: When the first coat can no longer be damaged; never more than approx. 2 kg/m² in one step.
WP_STEPS|/coatI2/overview: The second application step (and following) can take place when the first application step can no longer be damaged by reworking: overcoat after approx. 6 hours ({AQ1KP}: after approx. 90 minutes, even under unfavourable ambient conditions).
WP_STEPS|/coatI2/points/0: an application thickness of more than 2 kg/m² in one application step can lead to cracking
WP_STEPS|/coatI2/points/1: an even layer thickness with the coating thickness trowel or notched trowel, then smoothing
WP_STEPS|/coatI3/short: Standing seepage or pressing water: three application steps, approx. 5.3 kg/m².
WP_STEPS|/coatI3/overview: System “Basement waterproofing: the classic system”: {AQ1K} is applied as retroactive interior waterproofing in three layers for pressure water scenarios. WTA 4-6, standing seepage water / pressure water: > 3.0 mm dry film thickness ({AQ2K}: 5.3 kg/m²).
WP_STEPS|/coatI3/points/0: the upper limit of the consumption range (approx. 5.3 kg/m²) corresponds to the pressing water case
WP_STEPS|/coatI3/points/1: watertightness against negative pressing water up to 0.75 bar
WP_STEPS|/cureI/short: After hardening keep the surface damp for ≥ 24 hours; protect from rapid drying; no condensation.
WP_STEPS|/cureI/overview: After the coating has hardened, keep the surface damp for ≥ 24 hours. Protect the fresh coating from rain, wind, frost and direct sunlight. In rooms with high humidity and/or insufficient ventilation, dropping below the dew point (condensation) on the surface must be avoided by suitable measures such as condensation dryers.
WP_STEPS|/cureI/points/0: direct heating or uncontrolled blowing of warm air is not permitted
WP_STEPS|/cureI/points/1: foot traffic after approx. 24 hours; withstands pressurised water after ≥ 7 days
WP_STEPS|/plaster/short: THERMOPAL-SP splatterdash, THERMOPAL-SR24 (or THERMOPAL-ULTRA) restoration plaster, THERMOPAL-FS33 finish.
WP_STEPS|/plaster/overview: System “Basement waterproofing: the classic system”: after the interior waterproofing, the splatterdash coat {THSP} for adhesion, the restoration plaster {THSR} and, optionally, the finish coat THERMOPAL-FS33. The flexible system uses {THU}.
WP_STEPS|/plaster/points/0: the restoration plaster stores salts and lets the wall breathe: vapour permeable, climate regulating
WP_STEPS|/plaster/points/1: products of the subgroup “Mortars and restoration plasters” — follow their technical data sheets
WP_STEPS|/cleanW/short: Clean tools thoroughly with water after use. Store cool and dry, min. 12 months.
